author: Maya — Tactile Transduction and Sensing Physics
purpose: pressure from 1mN on taxel and fingertip area estimate
code_or_query:
import pint; Q=pint.UnitRegistry().Quantity
p_1mN_taxel = Q(0.001,'newton')/Q(6.25,'mm**2')
print('p taxel Pa:', p_1mN_taxel.to('Pa'))
# fingertip contact area ~ 15x20 mm
A_tip = Q(300,'mm**2')
print('fingertip area m2:', A_tip.to('m**2'))
# taxel count for 2.5mm pitch over 15x20mm
print('taxels:', (15/2.5)*(20/2.5))
# capacitive estimate: parallel plate C=epsA/d
import math
eps0=8.85e-12
A=Q(2.5,'mm')*Q(2.5,'mm')
d=Q(0.5,'mm')
C=(eps0*A.to('m**2').magnitude/d.to('m').magnitude)
print('C base pF:', C*1e12)
